name: rlv3_train
note: Each sibling rlv3 component owns its stage COMMAND; this driver owns only the contract. depends groups expand in rlv3/stages.py:GROUPS.

stages.name: index
stages.note: cheap, never skipped: records the draw this slice will be judged on
stages.cmd: {python} -u -c 'import json, os, sys; sys.path.insert(0, "{repo}"); from rlv3 import fingerprint as F; d = F.corpus_draw(); assert not d.get("missing"), "rl/datasets/session_index.json is missing"; open(os.path.join("{out}", "corpus_draw.json"), "w").write(json.dumps(d, indent=1)); print("draw n=%d counts=%s sha=%s" % (d["n"], d["counts"], d["draw_sha"][:8]))'

stages.name: clone
stages.note: top-band BC corpus. kaggriculture-top-player-bc-lifts-rl: cloning the readout from top-band sessions instead of our heuristic took the RL net 0.074-0.080 -> 0.127-0.180, replicated on 3 seeds.

stages.name: maia2
stages.note: the Maia-style per-destination executor model (rl/execnet). Built here so the slice graph owns it; whether it is USED is the executor component's call -- learned executors are refuted at -10 to -22 points on their own.

stages.name: bc
stages.note: --iters 0: clone only, no PPO. bc.pt is the PPO stage's --resume seed.

stages.name: ppo
stages.note: --session-mix eval, --plateau-cool 1.0 and --patience 99 are the three pins that make a slice boundary invisible; --lr/--ent-coef/--start-iter are written by rlv3.stages.ppo_slice.

stages.name: gate
stages.note: the 995-game band-stratified paired instrument. champ_h10 is the baseline every arm is paired against; dev:champion is the dev tree anchor. `inputs` ties this verdict to the candidate's BYTES: without it the gate skips itself after PPO appends more iterations, because its own session_eval.json is still there and the action space has not moved.

stages.name: card
stages.note: diagnosis attached to every promoted checkpoint, so a win or a loss says WHERE: planner/executor group gap, idle_share, one_time_units, plantings, fertilise, day-20 tile mix.

stages.name: promote
stages.note: in-process: rlv3.promote.promote under the lexicographic objective. Never the in-training SESSION-WR, never rl/train.py's best.pt argmax.
